intro: Review what you've learned about the four pillars.

questions.prompt: Which test type is more resistant to refactoring: white-box or black-box?
Which test type should you prioritize for an app with complex business rules, a simple UI, and limited CI time?
Which tests should you prioritize first in a legacy app with no tests, and why?

options.text: Unit tests, because they are easier to create
Integration tests, because they run faster
Unit tests, because they provide the strongest protection against regressions
E2E tests, because they provide the strongest resistance to refactoring
Integration tests, because they offer the best balance across all four pillars

questions.prompt: Which two attributes should every automated test maximize?

options.text: Resistance to refactoring and protection against regressions
